claims.claim: Born 13 February 1991 in Pau, Pyrénées-Atlantiques
claims.note: Source gives "Date de naissance : 13 février 1991" and "Lieu de naissance : Pau, Pyrénées-Atlantiques".

claims.claim: Age 35 as of November 2026
claims.note: Computed from the confirmed birth date; 35 on 2 November 2026.

claims.claim: First album "Idées blanches" released in 2014
claims.note: Source lists the album, released October 2014.

claims.claim: Stepped back from the media in June 2025
claims.note: Source says the retreat was announced in June 2025.

claims.claim: During the break he built a wooden cabin in the forest over about nine months
claims.note: Source says he built a wooden cabin alone in nature; Paris Match says nine months.

claims.claim: He became a carpenter / needed to become a bit of a carpenter to relearn singing
claims.note: Quoted "Peut-être qu'il faut que je sois un peu charpentier"; Paris Match says he "s'est mué en charpentier".

claims.claim: Cabin finished in April 2026
claims.note: RTBF: project completed after nine months, "en avril dernier".

claims.claim: Cabin now used as recording studio
claims.note: Paris Match: it "lui sert désormais de studio d'enregistrement".

claims.claim: Stayed in the cabin a full month to write and record
claims.note: Quoted: "posé ses valises dans ce refuge pendant un mois entier".

claims.claim: Recorded with no computer, only instruments and an old tape recorder
claims.note: Quoted: "Pas d'ordinateur. Juste mes instruments et un vieux magnétophone à bandes magnétiques."

claims.claim: Single "D'or et d'étain" written and recorded in the cabin
claims.note: Quoted: "À lire, écrire et enregistrer. Cette nouvelle chanson notamment."

claims.claim: Warned fans the result would not be perfect but human
claims.note: Quoted: "ce ne sera pas parfait, mais ce sera parfaitement humain".

claims.claim: Single released Friday 28 August 2026 at 00:01
claims.note: Article dated Monday 24 August 2026 says release "ce vendredi à minuit et une minute".

claims.claim: Song described as a love song mixing melancholy and hope
claims.note: Source: "Une déclaration d'amour teintée de mélancolie", positive note at chorus end.

claims.claim: Vianney said he had been chasing a freedom he needed to find again
claims.note: Quoted: "J'ai couru après une liberté qu'il me fallait retrouver".

claims.claim: Tour announced Monday 25 May 2026 in an Instagram video with a cardboard map of France
claims.note: RTBF describes the Instagram video and map; dated Monday 25 May.

claims.claim: Presale opened 27 May 2026; general sale Friday 29 May 2026 at 10:00
claims.note: Both sources give 27 May presale and Friday 29 May 10h general sale.

claims.claim: Tour opens in Reims on 24 March 2027
claims.note: Source: "On March 24, 2027, in Reims".

claims.claim: Three Paris Zénith La Villette dates on 8, 9 and 10 April 2027
claims.note: Both sources list 8, 9, 10 April 2027 at the Zénith de La Villette.

claims.claim: Geneva on 18 November 2027
claims.note: Source list: "18 Genève" in November 2027.

claims.claim: Brussels on 1 December 2027 at the ING Arena
claims.note: Source: "le 1er décembre 2027 à l'ING Arena".

claims.claim: About 40 dates announced
claims.note: Paris Match and RTBF say 40; Pure People says "près de 40 villes". Presented as a disagreement with Stéphane Larue.

claims.claim: Stéphane Larue reports more than 50 dates in France, Belgium and Switzerland
claims.note: Source: "Plus de 50 dates en France, Belgique et Suisse".

claims.claim: Final date 24 March 2028 in Narbonne
claims.note: Paris Match, Sortiraparis, Pure People and Stéphane Larue give 24 March 2028 in Narbonne (Sortiraparis gives Narbonne).

claims.claim: RTBF gives 18 March 2028 as the final date
claims.note: Source: tour runs to "le 18 mars de l'année suivante, en 2028".

valueNote: Gives a dated timeline from the break to the tour and states where sources disagree on the tour count and end date, with both citations.
summary: All checked claims are confirmed by opened sources. Removed an unconfirmed 41-entries count, an unsupported causal link, an unsourced geography detail and an unsupported clip-release detail in the pt FAQ.
